Name: Kenneth's Vast Farm - Super Wide
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]This one is for people who want to see everything in one panoramic view.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]240x65 = 15,600 tiles, triple vanilla. Same height as vanilla, but almost 3 screens wide. You literally need to run. Great if you want one mega field where you can see all your crops at once without scrolling up and down.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All tiles tillable, no dead spots.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]You get two versions:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Standard: Replaces normal farm, use for existing saves.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Additional Farms: New custom farm type for new saves, includes Day 1 restoration mail (gives back furniture + seeds if you had the old furniture bug).[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to install: SMAPI + Content Patcher, drop in Mods folder. 1.6 compatible.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This is Kenneth's Vast Farm - Super Wide.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Note: Inventory full at start? Place the Chest first, then store extra furniture inside. The Chest is there to help you.[/b][/size]

Downloads.Description: Old save? Use this one. Replaces vanilla Standard farm.
